title: Big Sister Dora
hook: 妈妈生了一对双胞胎，Dora 要当大姐姐了，还得穿过幽灵森林赶到医院。

cells.en: Wears diapers, sleeps in a cradle... The answer is a baby!
cells.cn: 穿尿布、睡摇篮……谜底是小宝宝！

cells.en: Backpack shows shapes under the red diamond.
cells.cn: 背包里露出形状，红菱形下面还藏着东西。

cells.en: Do you see the Spooky Forest on the way?
cells.cn: 你看见路上那片“幽灵森林”了吗？

cells.en: Isa the iguana knows the way through the trees.
cells.cn: 绿鬣蜥 Isa 认得穿过树林的路。

cells.en: Everyone shouts, “A baby, a baby, a baby!”
cells.cn: 大家一起喊：“宝宝，宝宝，宝宝！”

cells.en: Which one can take them? The wheel is right.
cells.cn: 哪一个能带他们去？方向盘那个才对。

cells.en: The train needs a green flag. Can you say verde, green?
cells.cn: 火车需要一面绿旗。你能说 verde（绿色）吗？

cells.en: Map checks the path to the big hospital.
cells.cn: 地图把去医院的路打上了勾。

cells.en: Dora holds the two new babies in her arms.
cells.cn: Dora 把两个新生儿抱在怀里。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Big Sister Dora”.
ending: In the end, Dora becomes a big sister to two babies. My favorite part is ______.
